Quest for Your farmer

Hazards on the way

  1. Seasons are less predictable

    Frost at flowering, heat during grain fill, dry starts and heavy downpours vary from year to year.

  2. Continuous cropping

    (for example wheat, canola, wheat, wheat) can run down soil organic matter and leave paddocks bare between crops.

  3. Changing a rotation is a trade-off

    A legume adds nitrogen but brings frost risk; a pasture phase builds soil but changes income and needs livestock.

    • SMAP + SRTM Soil moisture and slope.Optional · via NASA AppEEARS
